text:
devon: quick note 1: tried a cheap classifier-fallback for prefill on ozma-7b-q4_1. idea: run a tiny 2-layer classifier over first 6 tokens to predict whether full prefill is necessary (binary). if negative -> stream without prefill but keep 1 token warm. trying to avoid blanket entropy thresholds.

tariq: interesting. what's the classifier input? raw logits? embeddings?

devon: using pooled token embeddings from the first 6 tokens (mean pool) passed to a 128-d relu -> sigmoid head. trained on 50k prompts labeled by "prefill-needed" heuristics (oracle: run full prefill and compare top-1 token diff). small training run, 0.92 auc on val.

lola: concrete numbers? latency / quality tradeoffs?

devon: baseline (full prefill) vs clf-fallback (classifier decides): p50_token_ms 24.0 -> 20.9, p95_token_ms 92 -> 83, tokens-per-request -11% median. QA_EM(SQuAD_short) 86.1 -> 84.9 (1.2pt drop). hallucination rate (open-ended factual set) unchanged within noise.

tariq: 1.2pt EM hit is decent compared to earlier 5pt hits. did you stratify by prompt type?

devon: yes: questions with numeric answers still show small degradation (~2.5pt). prompts containing explicit retrieval anchors ("According to X") almost zero regressions. short definitional prompts worse.

lola: how much does classifier recall matter? false negatives -> skipped prefill on prompts that needed it. precision trades with latency. what threshold did you pick?

devon: threshold tuned to favor recall: thresh=0.35 (classifier score). recall ~0.94, precision ~0.60. raising threshold to 0.6 removes most EM hit but reduces token savings to ~5%.

tariq: can we cascade? classifier fast path -> if below high confidence but above low bound, run a 1-step probe (prefill 1 block) and reevaluate.

devon: implemented a cascade: score <0.15 => full prefill; 0.15<=score<0.6 => 1-block warm + quick re-score; >=0.6 => skip prefill. cascade run numbers: p50 22.1ms, p95 86ms, EM(SQuAD_short) 85.6 (0.5pt drop), token-savings ~8%. solid middle ground.

ci-bot: experiment job/9912 created comparing cascade vs baseline. dashboard: https://console.redwood/internal/runs/9912 :link:

lola: what about quant layout sensitivity? q4_1 vs q4f? small kernel-level noise can flip classifier features.
devon: I ran q4f quick: classifier AUC dropped to 0.88, EM delta widened by ~0.6pt. plan: fine-tune classifier on q4f activations and add temperature calibration.

tariq: add per-bucket metrics to the run: prompt length, interrogative vs declarative, presence of numerics, retrieval-anchor tag. also log span-length errors.

devon: will add. next steps: fine-tune on q4f, try cascade with 2-step probe for numeric-heavy prompts, and a canary rollout at 5% if the auto-block thresholds (EM drop>1.5pts short QA or p95>+6%) are not hit. posting artifacts in ~4h. :rocket:
